Experience Your Vacation Haven

Welcome to Tucked Away, a hidden gem along Florida's beautiful 30A, where tropical serenity meets effortless coastal luxury. Nestled among 42 graceful palm trees and backed by a peaceful pine forest, this private retreat invites you to slow down, soak up the sunshine, and embrace the beauty of the Emerald Coast. With a private heated pool, exclusive gated beach access just a short stroll away, and spacious accommodations for up to 15 guests, this is the perfect escape for families and friends seeking both relaxation and adventure.

Stepping inside, the open-concept design immediately feels warm and inviting. The first floor offers a beautifully equipped kitchen, a comfortable dining area, and a relaxed living space that brings everyone together after a long day by the water. A guest bedroom with a queen bed and a full bathroom completes the main level, creating a convenient retreat for those who prefer to stay downstairs.

Upstairs, the first of two master suites offers a king-sized bed, an ensuite bathroom, and a private balcony with a cozy bed swing and seating area, the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee as the coastal breeze rolls in. Just down the hall, a one-of-a-kind bunk area creates a kid’s dream space, featuring nine custom-built twin beds and a dedicated full bathroom designed with both comfort and fun in mind. The third-floor master suite is tucked away at the very top, providing another king-sized bed, a luxurious ensuite bathroom, and beautiful views of the surrounding treetops.

The outdoor space is just as inviting, designed for endless hours of relaxation and connection. The private heated pool, thoughtfully fenced for safety and privacy, offers the perfect place to cool off after a sun-drenched beach day. Multiple screened-in porches, a shaded dining area, and a BBQ grill make it easy to enjoy meals al fresco, while the gentle rustle of palm trees creates a serene backdrop. Just a five-minute walk from the front door, a private gated beach access leads to the soft, powdery sands and emerald waters of the Gulf, offering a truly uncrowded and exclusive stretch of shoreline.

Beyond the home, the best of 30A is within easy reach. A quick bike ride leads to the iconic beauty of Alys Beach, where whitewashed architecture and coastal elegance create a stunning atmosphere. Just a few minutes farther, Rosemary Beach offers charming cobblestone streets, boutique shopping, and some of the best dining in the area. For a more laid-back experience, The Big Chill (The Hub) provides an energetic space with live music, food trucks, and a fun, family-friendly vibe.

Tucked Away is more than just a vacation home—it’s an invitation to experience the magic of 30A at its finest. Whether you’re spending lazy afternoons by the pool, feeling the warm Gulf breeze on your skin, or exploring the hidden treasures of the coast, every moment here is designed to be unforgettable.

Reviewer Comments:
My family and I recently stayed at this house and we had a great time. The home was very clean, had plenty room, with all the amenities of home. We loved being tucked away and kind of hidden away. The house was located close to a grocery store and within biking distance of lots of nearby restaurants. My only complaint would be the walking distance from the beach. But that may be more because we’re so used to staying right on the beach. It was only about .25 miles but that would be tough with elderly family members because there is also lots of stairs down to the beach. There’s also a lot of stair climbing as theirs a room on the third floor. We knew that going in and was fine with it. Wish we could have rented a golf cart and kept it on location but the HOA only allows owners to have one. That doesn’t make sense to me. Overall, very happy with the house and would stay again!

reviews.text: This vacation rental is top notch. From the beautiful palm tree lined driveway to the private pool oasis area, it was perfection. The beds were comfortable. The property was quiet and felt very secluded. The kitchen was well stocked with everything needed to cook meals and the second refrigerator was a wonderful addition. The following information that I am going to provide are not complaints, but is meant to be informative. The walk to the private beach access isn’t bad, but the stairs down to the beach would be daunting for those with young children or mobility limitations. We didn’t spend as much time on the beach for this reason, but the pool area was so incredible, that we didn’t mind. I also had imagined that the area, as a whole, would be more walkable than it was. There are bikes on the property, but not everyone is comfortable bike riding. We drove our car when we wanted to explore, but traffic and parking were challenging. The property does not allow golf carts. Allowing golf carts would be ideal. The pool is surrounded by beautiful trees which is part of the charm. This also caused a lot of debris in the pool, which is expected. As a pool owner, this seems like a pool that probably needs to be vacuumed every other day, if not daily. I spent a lot of time skimming the pool with a net. If a vacuum had been provided, I would have been happy to do it myself. Someone stopped in to vacuum one time during our one week stay. I will stay at this property again. We loved it!
